board: SparkFun TFMini Plus - Micro LiDAR Module (SEN-15179)
reason: Lookup only matched the different TFmini-S skill (first-word match), so TFmini Plus was added as its own part. Modelled from the Benewake TFmini Plus manual: GH1.25-4P order +5V/RXD/TXD/GND, 5 V +/-0.5 V with 500 mA peak (external supply), 9-byte 0x59 0x59 frame at 100 Hz/115200 baud with sum8 checksum, temp = raw/8-256, distance 0 = unreliable; part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: Benewake TFmini Plus manual Table 4 and datasheet wiring guide (PIN-1 +5V red, PIN-2 RXD white, PIN-3 TXD blue, PIN-4 GND black), https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/1/4/2/1/9/TFmini_Plus_A02_Product_Manual_EN.pdf; https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/2/b/0/3/8/TFmini_Plus-01-A02-Datasheet_EN.pdf; https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15179
